findings.title: Standalone stale-LWC recovery passes an unusable raw frame
findings.description: The no-df fallback reads only OHLCV, but default supplied_ff Phase 2 requires 30 features. A stale or missing LWC archive therefore raises instead of rebuilding. Require a valid training frame or build the required feature frame, and add a real integration test.

findings.title: Missing archive hash aborts composition
findings.description: Schema validation permits absent archive_hash, while composition requires it after the load recovery block. A digest-valid archive with this field removed is not rebuilt or cleanly rejected.

findings.title: Direct Phase 2 pool seeding bypasses feature identity
findings.description: load_pool validates only shape. run, run_epoch, and finalize_island can seed a stale pool when names and chromosome shape remain unchanged; the orchestrator sidecar is not enforced at those entry points.

findings.title: Recovery tests do not execute the real LWC rebuild
findings.description: The tests mock run_phase2, so they prove callback invocation but not the production 30-feature source path or missing archive_hash recovery.

findings.title: Untracked artifact exists outside .opencode
findings.description: This appears to be prior-run scratch, but Nexus approval requires no workspace changes outside .opencode.
